item.description:
• Amanu is now a $29 one-time purchase with a full-featured 14-day free trial. The trial starts on first launch; the menu bar shows the days remaining as the end approaches, and Settings gains a License pane for entering the license key from your purchase email. Everything stays on-device: the license is verified offline and dictation never touches the network.
  • While the speech model is still downloading, dictating now shows "Downloading speech model" with live progress in the HUD instead of appearing to hang, and the setup window's try-it step shows the download progress before inviting you to dictate.
  • The setup window now opens centered on the screen you are working on.
  • New floating orb HUD: pick Orb under Settings > General > Appearance for a small always-on-top circle you can drag anywhere on screen. Hold the hotkey and it unfurls the live waveform toward the screen center, shows your draft underneath while you speak, flashes a checkmark, and collapses back to a resting circle - without ever stealing focus or blocking clicks around it.
  • The HUD Position control is now a single Appearance choice: Notch, Capsule, or Orb.
  • The orb remembers where you left it, per display, and finds its way back on-screen when displays are unplugged or resolutions change.
  • If dictation fails while using the orb (a password field has focus, the mic is unavailable), the error panel still appears and explains why.
  • VoiceOver announces dictation progress in orb mode just as it does for the capsule.
